text:
sam: quick check — CI docs render failing for runtime quickstart. the anchor `#deploy` returns 404 when previewing the page.

sam: output from preview-lint:
```
GET https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/quickstart#deploy -> 404 Not Found
render: runtime/quickstart.md:line 72: anchor 'deploy' not found
```

sam: anyone owning runtime/quickstart? pinging @maria since you touched it last month.

maria: I can take a look. is it only the anchor or whole page missing? I think we renamed the section to 'deploying' in the rewrite.

owen: looks like a rename. quick sed to fix all links in site: `git grep -l "#deploy" | xargs sed -i "s/#deploy/#deploying/g"` — but better to update the source heading to a canonical anchor `deploy` if that's the standard.

karla: prefer updating links (less churn) — but will this break localized versions? check ja/* and es/*.

maria: good call. i'll open a tiny PR that updates internal references and adds a redirect in frontmatter. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — small description and smoke test.

sam: thanks! can you drop the smoke command in the PR description? e.g. `curl -sSf -I https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/quickstart#deploy | head -n 1` so reviewers can verify.

docs-bot: docs-scan detected 1 broken anchor in runtime/quickstart — assigned to maria. (auto-ticket #DOCS-884)

owen: :thumbsup: i'll review the PR this afternoon.

karla: i'll spot-check ja/ and es/ once PR is up. thanks maria.

maria: opening PR now, ETA ~30m.
